description: Delete a workspace provider by slug. This is irreversible and will break prompts, configs, and virtual keys that reference it; use delete_integration for the org source instead. Returns success after the provider is removed.

slug.description: The slug of the provider to delete

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID - required when using organization admin keys

name: delete_provider

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
